notes: North is up. Scale ~3.44 px/ft. W. Liberty runs diagonally (falls ~0.265 px per px to the east); its centre is taken midway between the block lines on each side (north side is the outline of the Vol 3 blocks). The Vol 3 block outline north of Liberty is unbroken from Elm to Race and from Race to Vine, so Pleasant and Republic end at Liberty (T); a short break in that line at x~2850-2913 is where the compass needle is drawn, not a street. Pine (block 5) and Spruce (block 6) are 15' alleys printed 'ALLEY' north half and 'PINE'/'SPRUCE' south half; both run 15th to 14th and continue south across 14th (gap in the sheet-66 blocks). The 10' alley in block 3 (x~2487) and in block 4 (x~3218) run Liberty to 15th, printed only 'ALLEY'; each lines up with an alley south of 15th printed 'GOOSE' (x~2497) and 'PARVIS (RIDGEWAY)' (x~3221), which run 15th to 14th and stop at 14th; the 15th crossings are recorded under the southern names. W. 15th jogs at Elm (west part centre y~2667, east part ~2795). W. 14th is 50' west of Race and 33' east of Race (north line jogs from y~4195 to ~4222, south line from ~4370 to ~4334); centres ~4282 and ~4280. Elm west side T's (Wade, Dover Alley, Odeon, W. 15th west part, Wetsel Alley, Magnolia, Adrian Alley) are sheet-75 streets whose ends are outlined here. East of Vine only block outlines (SEE VOLUME TWO): W. 15th and W. 14th do not continue east of Vine; the two openings in the east line, at y~2422-2562 and ~3770-3884, are named Mary and Allison from the Vol 2 key map order (Liberty, Mary, Allison, Mercer going south) - not printed on this sheet, treat as tentative. Liberty and Vine continue north into Vol 3.
